title: Dissectors: Eliminate some extra string copies
description:
Replace cases where strings are fetched just to convert into
integers with tvb_get_string_[u]int

AI-Assisted: no

notes.body:
The C standard `strtol`, (and also the GLib functions) doesn't fail if there are trailing non numeric characters of any type. If the parameter that would hold the pointer to the character after the last one interpreted is NULL, it simply doesn't ignores it but still will return what it gets.

The `ws_strtoi` functions, by contrast, have always had strict interpretation if that parameter is NULL, failing if there are trailing non numerics (including whitespace.) In order to behave like `strtol` a pointer must be passed in.

I don't know if that usage should be strict or not, because it, like so many others, doesn't have error checking, but putting `endoff` preserves the existing behavior. (Which may not be optimal, I agree.)

In the case here, while IMF and SIO labels allow linear whitespace before and after the '=', this dissector also calls `tvb_skip_wsp_return` so the strict interpretation should be good here. I just didn't take that closer look before and simply preserved the preexisting behavior.
